schema_version: v0 — component-charter shape; migrates into the intention envelope when MAP.md Q6 lands
what: A thin web presentation surface (Law 7) over the running system — the devices on the heartbeat across the TOP (the roster, child c), the selected device's ACTIVE page BELOW (its panes: STATUS / SETTINGS floor + declared interaction/logging, child a). Three parts under one charter: (1) render.py — PURE functions `data -> html` (nav, panes, document), no I/O, no socket, everything a device says HTML-escaped; (2) server.py — `WebServerDevice`, a Form v0 #2 device whose `serve(path) -> (status, content_type, html)` routes a request to a rendered page, reaching each device's `active_page()` live THROUGH the ground_loop that beats it (in-process v0); (3) listener.py — the thin http.server wrapper binding the port (all interfaces — loopback + the box's LAN address; Akien's ruling 2026-08-08) and handing each GET and POST to `serve`, the OS-specific piece the proof does not exercise. NOT a daemon (the law: NO DAEMONS — UU's daemon sprawl is why the ground loop owns the one heartbeat): it acts only when an external call arrives; the rename from daemon.py says so. THERE IS ONLY EVER ONE WEB SERVER IN THE WHOLE SYSTEM — a device that wants a face owns a PAGE this server displays through its shim's declared panes; nobody else binds a port. The web server owns NO device state: `/` is the landing (nav + pick-a-device), `/device/<id>` is that device's ACTIVE page — GET renders it, POST hands the decoded form to the device THROUGH ITS SHIM (`deliver`, which starts the device if it is not running; a hidden `channel` field names the device's mail channel; the surface adds no routing intelligence), an unknown device is a loud coherent 404 that still renders the nav.
why: Telos 2 — Cairn has a USER; the librarian needs a web interface, and 'a web interface falls out of the chatbot' only if the surface exists first. This is that surface, on the spine BEFORE the librarian (MAP.md build order: web server → harbor_master → librarian-as-chatbot). It is the Form v0 #2 introspection surface made concrete — the SAME protocol the tester probes and the web UI renders, so observability is not a separate build. Built as a PRESENTATION surface (Law 7: it may collapse an error into a coherent shape — the 404, the absent-pane reason — but holds no record of truth and produces no DATA of its own), which is exactly what keeps the intelligence in the shims and the web server trivial (Law 6: one owner, no state). Because it renders DATA the devices produce (never markup a device authored), a hostile string in a device's feed can never become the page's markup — escaping is physics here, not diligence.
invoke: import: `from cairn.devices.web_server.server import WebServerDevice` (over a ground_loop) and `from cairn.devices.web_server import render`. Prove: `python3 cairn/devices/web_server/proofs/test_web_server.py` + `test_web_server_chat.py` (exit 0 = green), or under the tester. Run the listener: `python3 cairn/devices/web_server/listener.py [--port 80] [--bind 0.0.0.0]` — binds all interfaces (loopback + LAN); v0 wires the ground loop with the librarian's shim subscribed (the chat window live at /device/librarian), the full heartbeat still the launcher's filed edge.
entry: FRESH design, standard mechanism, converged with Akien 2026-07-21 (the web_server design conversation: surfaces-in-the-shim, the data/render split, the artifact-owner spinoff, 'i think web server is /sorted'). The mechanism is ordinary Python stdlib (http.server, html.escape, json) — nothing crossed as carried code; UU's web surfaces are not grafted. The intelligence is deliberately elsewhere (the panes are child a's BaseShim machinery; the nav is child c's ground_loop roster), so this device is a bridge + frame renderer and little else — minimalism by construction.
state_and_history: compiled to state.json (projected window) + history.json (append-only voyage) beside this charter — the charter-state-history split; this file stays pure intention+why, the operational voyage lives in the sidecars (Law 1/4/7)
filed_edges: (a) THE BUS TRANSPORT — v0 reaches devices in-process through the ground_loop; fetching active_page over the bus lands when devices are separate OS processes
(b) REPORTED-vs-FILED DRIFT on the STATUS pane — comparing the reported intention against the filed intention+why.json on disk is this surface's render-time job and is not yet wired

(c) NARROWED 2026-07-27, RE-TRUED 2026-07-28 — the librarian's chat window LANDED as the first rich view IN THE PANE MACHINERY (render_pane dispatches kind 'chat' to a transcript + form view; the form POSTs back to the device's own page with a hidden channel field; first cast as a bespoke /chat route, corrected same-arc to the declared-pane shape — one web server, surfaces in the shim); what remains: rich views for OTHER devices' interaction panes still render as pretty JSON until each pulls its own

(d) THE VOYAGE PANE — BUILT + PROVEN 2026-07-24 (render.render_traffic_image + the /harbor route + proofs/test_voyage_pane.py, 4 teeth, sealed under a real netns). Renders harbor_master's TRAFFIC IMAGE (child c) — the whole-fleet, state-right-now view — as a fleet-wide route (⚓ Harbor in the nav on every page), distinct from the per-device pages. The harbor source is INJECTED (not imported — the data/render split holds); a surface with none says so loudly (404). Because the traffic image is computed from disk (the register), /harbor renders the REAL fleet from a bare daemon TODAY — the first live human-visible Cairn surface (Telos 2).
(e) the SETTINGS circuit-breaker (waits on the cgroup-kill sudo script)
(f) the LAUNCHER wiring the real running heartbeat (instance-space); listener.py stands up the ground loop with the librarian's shim subscribed today
gates: proof gate (tester) — proofs/test_web_server.py, run by the tester; verdict+seal from the same hand. Durability gate (code-seam): not done until proven, VALIDATION persisted beside-code (validations/test_web_server.json), AND committed. The socket listener is exempt by construction (the unprovable-without-the-OS thin wrapper) — the route+render logic under it carries the proof.
falsifier: the surface is honest and thin — RED on any of: (1) a device's ACTIVE page shows a pane it did NOT declare, or omits the STATUS/SETTINGS floor (the pane set is child a's, not the web server's to invent); (2) a device-derived string reaches the page as live markup (escaping failed — Law 7, and a real injection); (3) the web server accretes its own state/cache of device internals (it becomes a second record of truth — the state() must stay pulled-live); (4) an error renders as a raw crash/stack instead of a coherent shape (Law 7's presentation half); (5) a device NOT on the heartbeat is viewable, or one ON it is not (the nav must be exactly the roster). Wrong-shape signal: if rendering logic migrates INTO the shims (shims emitting HTML instead of DATA), the data/render split has failed and the tester can no longer probe the same protocol the UI renders.
horizon: first REAL render — when the listener serves the actual running heartbeat (the launcher wires it) with at least two live devices' ACTIVE pages pulled over the bus, STATUS reported-vs-filed drift-detection works, and the LOGGING pane reads real emission. Re-check then: is BaseShim the right home for the pane machinery, or do too many devices override it? (The data/render split survived its first rich interaction pane — the librarian's chat window, 2026-07-28: the device hands DATA, render_pane owns the view, the POST travels as mail.)
how_it_learns: As a presentation surface, its learning is the DRIFT it makes visible, not a model it trains. STATUS puts a device's reported intention beside its filed one — the reported-vs-filed comparison (open edge b) is a live drift detector (Law 3: a device that has quietly become something other than its charter says shows up on its own page). The surface itself does not learn autonomously — by design, it holds no state to learn from; the learning it SERVES is every device's, made observable. Its own horizon: today it renders introspection DATA; when interaction panes bring rich views and the LOGGING pane reads real emission, the surface deepens as its consumers (the librarian's chat/tool page) pull them. TRACE-WIRED 2026-08-01 (deploy pass, Akien-approved): every request is a firing at learning_block's trace wire — a 200 traces door_pass, a 404/500 traces send_back with the lack named; the surface still collapses the error into a coherent page (Law 7), the wire only makes the refusal COUNTED in the system-level denominator (I-the-system-is-a-learning-block). Best-effort by the surface's own law: a broken wire is loud on stderr, never a broken page.
traces_to: Telos 2 (Cairn has a USER — the librarian's web interface rests on this surface)
Form v0 #2 (MAP.md:157 — the uniform introspection surface; one protocol for tester + web UI)
Law 7 (a presentation surface may collapse an error into a coherent shape; a record of truth never may — and never lets a device's data become markup)
Law 6 (the web server owns no state — content is each device's, reached through the heartbeat that holds it)
Law 4 (escaping + the data/render split are physics, not diligence)
Law 1 (every later surface is a read-projection of the panes + roster, not re-derived)
build order: web server, after inference domain (MAP.md build order)
owner: CC owns web_server's code + proofs and gates writes to them. Akien owns the design ratification (surfaces-in-the-shim, the data/render split, 'i think web server is /sorted', 2026-07-21). The listening PORT is owned by the web_server device (Law 6); the socket is the listener's.
proof: proofs/test_web_server.py — the nav is the roster; a device page renders its panes pulled live through the heartbeat; an unknown device is a coherent 404 that still renders the nav; every device string is escaped; an absent pane renders its reason; the web server owns no state (a Form v0 #2 device, state pulled live). Composes a REAL ground_loop + REAL BaseShims + a REAL device, so it proves route → fetch-through-the-heartbeat → render WITHOUT a socket. proofs/test_web_server_chat.py — the librarian's chat window through the STANDARD machinery (librarian-chat-surface ticket; a real LibrarianShim on a real ground loop, its face injected): the librarian rides the roster and its page carries the chat pane with the summarize: affordance SAID; querying the page WAKES the device through its shim; POST delivers the decoded form through shim.deliver; an empty utterance takes no turn; every librarian string is escaped; a dying delivery is a legible 500 whose breadcrumb stands; an unwoken face is an ABSENT pane, and the old /chat route is an ordinary 404 (no second door). Green: both scripts exit 0.
provenance: Born 2026-07-22 as the next step of the code spine after inference_domain, building the web-server ticket (cast 2026-07-21 via /sorted). Children a (BaseShim pane machinery) and c (ground_loop roster) landed first as the two DATA providers, each proven + persisted beside-code; b (this device — the surface that renders them) is the third buildable child. child d (the VOYAGE pane / ⚓ Harbor route) BUILT + PROVEN 2026-07-24 the moment its graft (harbor_master child c, the traffic image) landed the same session — rendering the whole-fleet state-right-now view; child e (circuit breaker) remains deferred on the cgroup-kill sudo script. Advances Telos 2 from thesis to a REAL surface: /harbor renders the live fleet from a bare start (the traffic image is disk-computed, independent of the running heartbeat). 2026-07-28: the librarian's chat window landed as the first rich interaction pane (librarian-chat-surface ticket) — first cast as a bespoke /chat route + injected source, corrected on Akien's word to the ratified shape (ONE web server; a device owns a PAGE; surfaces live in the shim; the shim starts its device; POST travels as mail through deliver), and daemon.py became listener.py with the NO DAEMONS law written into it. The full heartbeat still awaits the launcher (the filed instance-space edge).
learns: It does not; it is the HTTP server — it serves pages without learning from requests.
